import os, psycopg, json

dsn = os.environ.get("APP_DB_URL", "").strip()
assert dsn, "APP_DB_URL missing"
conn = psycopg.connect(dsn)
cur = conn.cursor()

cur.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM actimize_screening_type_mappings")
total = cur.fetchone()[0]
cur.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM actimize_screening_type_mappings WHERE screening_type_name IS NULL OR btrim(screening_type_name) = ''")
blanks = cur.fetchone()[0]
cur.execute("SELECT screening_type_name, count(*) FROM actimize_screening_type_mappings GROUP BY screening_type_name HAVING count(*) > 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC, screening_type_name")
dups = cur.fetchall()
cur.execute("SELECT screening_type_name FROM actimize_screening_type_mappings ORDER BY screening_type_name")
vals = [r[0] for r in cur.fetchall()]

print("PK_CHECK", json.dumps({"total": total, "blanks": blanks, "duplicate_groups": len(dups), "duplicates": dups, "values": vals}, ensure_ascii=False))
cur.close()
conn.close()
